about.title: About AL-FAHMU Learning Centre
about.description: AL-FAHMU Learning Centre helps children grow through academic excellence, Islamic values, character building, and confidence-focused support. We believe every learner deserves patient guidance, meaningful structure, and a safe environment to progress at their own pace.

mission.title: Our Mission
items: To provide learning guidance that focuses on understanding, not memorisation alone.
To help students master the foundations of reading, Quran recitation, and academics in a gradual and consistent way.
To create a learning environment that is comfortable, guided, and disciplined.
To guide students according to their individual ability level, not only by age or school form.
To work together with parents in monitoring each child's development.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To nurture students who master and understand the foundations of knowledge, have good character, and feel confident in learning.

objectives.title: Our Objectives
items: To help students read fluently and understand what they read.
To ensure students master the basics of Quran recitation, pronunciation, and proper learning etiquette.
To strengthen the academic foundations of primary school students in core subjects.
To improve the understanding and confidence of secondary school students in learning.
To shape students who are disciplined, confident, and motivated to learn.
